static_traits.name: Lin Xuan
static_traits.marital_status: In a relationship with a boyfriend living in Italy
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with boyfriend affected by feelings of inadequacy; has not yet confided related feelings to Mother
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; no psychotherapy received yet; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Somewhat nervous, clear expression, relatively cooperative, willing to try recording thoughts

basic_info.main_problem: Since burning the lasagna I made, I have been experiencing feelings of not being good enough and the pressure of becoming a 'perfect wife'.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this feeling of not being good enough is affecting my self-esteem and relationship, so I seek counseling to work on these issues.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether I can become a perfect wife
If I cannot do housework well (e.g. cooking), I am not good enough / not qualified

special_situations.event: Burned the lasagna made for boyfriend (wanted to impress the boyfriend living in Italy with Italian food)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even cook a simple meal well, it means I am not suited to be a wife and will disappoint him
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to improve cooking skills, while avoiding cooking for boyfriend and avoiding marriage topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even cook a simple dish well; I will become a terrible wife.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail again, it will prove I am incompetent, and the future marriage will fail too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Cooking less, procrastinating or Avoids cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It will go wrong again; he will think less of me.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My partner will judge me by my housework ability; once I am not good enough I will Be rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing marriage with boyfriend, Repressing true feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He will think I am troublesome / not worth it.

special_situations.event: Thinking of boyfriend in Italy, hoping to impress him by cooking Italian food
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by meeting the other person's and the outside world's standards and recognition do I count as valuable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly caters to the other's face and cultural expectations, seeking affirmation through performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must prove through this dish that I am accepted by him.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be loved and accepted, affirmed as a partner / future wife
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being belittled or Being rejected for being imperfect, even leading to relationship breakdown
defense_goal: Avoiding being judged by pursuing perfection
Maintaining some avoidance and distance to lower the risk of Being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: An unqualified wife-to-be who fails easily
object_relations.object_representation: A picky significant other (boyfriend) who will be disappointed and may belittle oneself
object_relations.linking_affect: Shame, anxiety, Fear of being judged

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When boyfriend asks caringly 'is something wrong' or notices her changes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I admit the trouble, he will find me troublesome and inadequate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Say 'I'm fine' in a dismissive tone, quickly change the topic, avoid in-depth discussion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When marriage topics arise or one is expected to show housework/cooking ability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: He will pick faults like a judge and negate me
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Speak cautiously and vaguely, stressing 'it is not convenient to talk now', attributing unease to his possible reaction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to explore the emotions and needs behind mistakes (for example, focusing on the burnt-food incident in counseling)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Expressing vulnerability will expose incompetence and bring disappointment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Interpret with objective reasons (e.g. 'just poor timing'), downplaying emotional coloring, avoiding talk of shame and Fear.

manifestations: A strong role expectation and self-demand of 'becoming a perfect wife', equating choices and responsibilities with having to be perfect
Worrying that one mistake means future marriage failure
outcomes: Avoiding cooking and avoiding marriage topics

manifestations: Worrying about being negated and not daring to express true feelings to boyfriend
Not yet confiding unease to Mother even though she lives with her
outcomes: Support system not yet effectively utilized

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Uses 'must be a perfect wife' as an inner criterion to evaluate oneself
Measures one's own worth by external standards and others' expectations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing troubles to boyfriend, turning energy toward self-Repression and avoidance
Worrying 'do not make him worry', thus seeking less help

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming boyfriend will find her 'too troublesome / not capable enough', thus avoiding communication

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly blaming herself 'I am not good enough', being extra careful in the relationship and communication to avoid exposing mistakes

exception_events.target_problem: In situations related to the partner relationship and marriage, the client typically catastrophizes and Self-denies, thus Avoiding cooking and avoiding marriage topics.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In one Work project, the client earned Good performance and positive feedback, experiencing herself as capable — different from her usual reaction of 'one mistake negates the whole self'.
exception_events.reason: Different situation/approach: Work tasks have clear boundaries and explicit standards, focusing on concrete steps and execution, making it easier to see her own ability, hence a more in-control experience.

positive_force: Has experience of competence in work settings; can see her own competence from successes
Willing to seek help and try recording automatic thoughts, has motivation for change
Having usable family support resources (Mother living with her)
negative_force: Rigid belief and perfection standards that tie self-worth to being a 'perfect wife'
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind reading
Avoidant coping (not cooking / not discussing marriage) maintains Anxiety and Self-denial
Tends to seek external recognition, ignoring evidence of one's own existing abilities

antecedent: Thinking of or starting to cook for boyfriend
Recalling the experience of burning the lasagna
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one mistake as 'I am not suited to be a wife', and catastrophizing the consequences, worrying about being judged
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and shame, temporarily reducing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Maintaining and worsening Anxiety about cooking, declining Self-efficacy, affecting daily life and intimate relationship

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding discussing marriage / communication about the future
antecedent: When talking about marriage with boyfriend
Being asked whether there are problems or about future plans
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading-style prediction that he will negate her, internalizing the Fear of Being rejected as avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible conflict or Being rejected, temporarily keeping surface calm
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship grows distant, communication decreases, worries persist
